analogy.rationale: ENTPD3 (NTPDase3) hydrolyzes extracellular ATP/ADP to AMP and is poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so NTPDase inhibitors should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other purinergic/ATP-pathway modulators, though they act at different nodes and would also be largely inactive or only weakly active here.
